value.name: asks to reopen sewing room later
value.description: Asha says she wants to return the next day with everyone present before the sewing room is opened.
evidence: "I'd like to come back tomorrow with everyone present before this is opened."
she stepped back into the hallway and pulled the sewing room door gently closed behind her.

value.name: identifies October attorney
value.description: Rosa recalls the name of the other attorney who called in October and explains why the family chose him over Mr. Halloran.
evidence: "Stein. Or Stine. He was younger than Mr. Halloran. The señora said she did not want to use Mr. Halloran for the change because Mr. Halloran was Mr. Serrano's friend from the parish, and she wanted — she said the word — fresh eyes."

value.name: thanks Rosa and leaves room
value.description: Asha thanks Rosa, and the two women walk back down the hallway together.
evidence: Rosa nodded once. They walked back down the hallway together,

value.name: Rosa defends the boy
value.description: At the top of the stairs, Rosa stops Asha and asks her to understand that the boy is not bad but burdened by being made the man of the house too young.
evidence: At the top of the stairs Rosa stopped and put her hand lightly on Asha's forearm — not a grip, just a touch — and said, "Ms. Patel. The boy is not a bad boy. I want you to know that. He is a boy who was told he was the man of the house when he was twelve years old, and he has been trying to be that ever since, and his mother did not always know how to take it back from him. I am not asking you to be kind to him. I am asking you to know."

value.name: Asha promises to remember
value.description: Asha accepts Rosa's warning and promises to remember what she has said about the boy.
evidence: Rosa nodded again, and let go.

value.name: Asha leaves the house
value.description: Asha exits the house at 1:20 p.m. and heads into the neighborhood.
evidence: Asha left the house at twenty past one.

value.name: Asha sits in coffee shop without calling
value.description: After walking two blocks, Asha sits in a coffee shop with an untouched drink and delays calling anyone while thinking.
evidence: She walked two blocks before she found a coffee shop with a window seat and ordered a flat white she did not drink and sat with her phone in her hand and did not call anyone for ten minutes.

value.name: Asha reflects on father's portfolio and Daniel's warning
value.description: While sitting alone, Asha thinks about her father's portfolio and Daniel's statement that there is no later.
evidence: She was thinking about her father's portfolio. She was thinking about the way Daniel had said *there is no later
